rule_en: Review: real future → If + present, will; unreal now → If + past, would; unreal past → If + past perfect, would have; wish mirrors the same shifts; unless = if not.
rule_bn: রিভিউ: বাস্তব ভবিষ্যৎ → will; অবাস্তব বর্তমান → would; অবাস্তব অতীত → would have; wish-ও একই নিয়মে পেছায়; unless = যদি না।

sessions.title: Spot the Error
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the wrong word, then choose the fix.

items.prompt_en: If the import will finish early, I will review the results tonight
items.explain_en: No 'will' in the if-clause: present simple.

items.prompt_en: If I had a spare sandbox, I will test the package there
items.explain_en: Unreal present (If + past) → would + base.

items.prompt_en: If you had flagged the risk, we would have plan around it
items.explain_en: would have + past participle: planned.

items.prompt_en: The oldest jobs get dropped if the queue overflow
items.explain_en: Zero conditional: 'queue' is singular → overflows.

items.prompt_en: I wish we have a staging org that matched production
items.explain_en: Present wish → wish + past simple.

items.prompt_en: Unless you don't hear from me, assume the deploy went fine
items.explain_en: 'Unless' already means 'if not' — keep the verb positive.

items.prompt_en: If we had chosen Flutter, we will have one codebase now
items.explain_en: Past choice → present result: would + base (have).

items.prompt_en: She wouldn't has missed the alert if the pager had worked
items.explain_en: wouldn't + have + past participle.

items.prompt_en: You can demo from my org as long as you will log out after
items.explain_en: 'as long as' takes the present simple.

items.prompt_en: If only I listened to the architect before building this
items.explain_en: Past regret → if only + past perfect.

sessions.title: Choose & Fill
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the correct option or chip.

items.prompt_en: If we ___ the contract last month, we would be staffed by now.
items.explain_en: Past condition for a present result → past perfect.

items.prompt_en: If you ___ a flaky test, quarantine it the same day.
items.explain_en: General policy → zero conditional: present simple.

items.prompt_en: I wouldn't ship on a Friday ___ the fix were truly urgent.
items.explain_en: The only exception → unless = if not.

items.prompt_en: If only we ___ more time before the audit.
items.explain_en: If only + past simple for a present wish.

items.prompt_en: If the cert exam ___ easier, everyone would have one.
items.explain_en: Unreal present → were.

items.prompt_en: If the build breaks, the bot ___ the commit author automatically.
items.explain_en: An automatic rule → zero conditional, present simple.

items.prompt_en: I would have joined the beta if I ___ about it.
items.explain_en: Third conditional if-clause: past perfect.

items.prompt_en: We'll keep the legacy API running ___ customers still depend on it.
items.explain_en: For the duration of the condition → as long as.

items.prompt_en: I wish the sprint board ___ itself after each release.
items.explain_en: wish + past simple for a present wish.

items.prompt_en: If I ___ you, I'd take the certification voucher before it expires.
items.explain_en: Advice → If I were you.

sessions.title: Build It
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the tiles in the right order. For speak items, say it out loud.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: If the migration fails , we will restore the backup .
items.explain_en: First conditional: present in the if-clause, will in the result.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: If I had admin access , I would fix this myself .
items.explain_en: Second conditional: If + past, would + base.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: If we had labeled the tickets , triage would have been quick .
items.explain_en: Third conditional: unreal past on both sides.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: If the token expires , refresh it and retry .
items.explain_en: Conditional + imperative result.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: I wish deployments were completely boring .
items.explain_en: wish + past simple (were) for a present wish.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: Unless the client objects , we will launch on Monday .
items.explain_en: unless + present simple; will in the main clause.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: Provided that the numbers hold , the board will approve the budget .
items.explain_en: provided that = strict condition for the result.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: If I had set an alert , I would know the answer .
items.explain_en: Mixed: past condition → present result (would know).

items.prompt_en: Make a real promise about your next release using a first conditional.
items.model_en: If the smoke tests pass, I will promote the build to production.

items.prompt_en: Say one 'if only' regret from this month.
items.model_en: If only I had estimated that ticket more honestly.

sessions.title: Mixed Drill
sessions.instruction_en: All four types, shuffled. Beat the clock.

items.prompt_en: We will rollback quickly if anything will look wrong
items.explain_en: The if-clause stays present simple.

items.prompt_en: If the demo ___ , we would have lost the account.
items.explain_en: Unreal past → if + past perfect.

items.prompt_en: I wish this meeting ___ a clear agenda for once.
items.explain_en: Present wish → past simple: had.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: If the API were public , adoption would explode .
items.explain_en: Second conditional: were + would.

items.prompt_en: Nobody touches the config unless they don't have approval
items.explain_en: 'unless' is already negative — the clause stays positive.

items.prompt_en: If I hadn't automated the reports, I ___ them every Friday now.
items.explain_en: Past condition → present habit result: would + base.

items.prompt_en: If we ___ unlimited budget, we'd buy everyone an M4.
items.explain_en: Unreal present → if + past simple.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: If you find a security bug , report it immediately .
items.explain_en: Conditional + imperative: report it.

items.prompt_en: If she had stayed calm, she would have pass the system design round
items.explain_en: Past participle after 'would have': passed.

items.prompt_en: You'll get the refund ___ you cancel within thirty days.
items.explain_en: A strict condition → provided that.
